ESQW.description: Construction Stage Loads (ESQW). A single construction-stage-wizard record (key 1) driving the construction dead load case, the erection sequence list (per-step model selection by material type or material name), and additional load cases applied per story.

LCNAME.description: Construction Dead Load Case: name of the static load case (STLD) used as the construction dead load. Must reference an existing load case name.

ESQW_SEQ_LIST.description: Erection Sequence List: one entry per construction step defining the story for dead load, stage duration, member age, and the model selection items.

ITEMS.description: Model Selection for Each Steps: per-step model selections. At most D_ESEQ_NUMESEQ items are applied by the handler (extra items are ignored).

MODEL_TYPE.description: Model Type (case-insensitive). MATL_TYPE => MODEL_MATL is a material category (see MATL_TYPE); MATL_NAME => MODEL_MATL is an existing material name.

MATL_TYPE.description: Material Type (case-insensitive). Material category used when MODEL_TYPE=MATL_TYPE: ALL, STEEL, CONC, SRC, or USER.

MODEL_MATL.description: Model Material Name. When MODEL_TYPE=MATL_TYPE this is a material category token; when MODEL_TYPE=MATL_NAME this is an existing material name.

MODEL_STORY.description: Model Story Name: existing story name whose members are activated in this step. Must reference an existing story.

STORY_FOR_DL.description: Story for Dead Load: existing story name to which the construction dead load is applied at this step. Must reference an existing story.

DURATION.description: Stage Duration: duration of the construction stage (days).

AGE.description: Member Age: age of the member at activation (days).

ESQW_LC.description: Load Cases: additional dead load cases applied to specific stories with a starting day.

LCNAME.description: Load Case: name of the additional static load case (STLD). Must reference an existing load case name.

ITEMS.description: Additional Load Items: per-story starting-day entries for this load case.

START_DAY.description: Start Day: day on which the additional load starts for this story.

STORY.description: Story Name: existing story name the additional load is applied to. Must reference an existing story.
